```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("quantify")

coverm_dir <- p("results", "quantify", "coverm")
read_coverm <- function(level, method) {
  file <- file.path(coverm_dir, paste0(level, ".", method, ".tsv"))
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  read_table_quiet(file)
}
genome <- list(
  count = read_coverm("genome", "count"), tpm = read_coverm("genome", "tpm"),
  covered = read_coverm("genome", "covered_bases"), length = read_coverm("genome", "length")
)
contig <- list(count = read_coverm("contig", "count"), covered = read_coverm("contig", "covered_bases"), length = read_coverm("contig", "length"))

mapping <- map_dfr(libraries(), function(library) {
  flagstat <- p("results", "quantify", "bowtie2", paste0(library, ".flagstats.txt"))
  if (!file.exists(flagstat)) return(NULL)
  bind_cols(tibble(library = library), read_flagstat(flagstat))
})

longer <- function(table, value) {
  pivot_longer(table, -1, names_to = "library", values_to = value) %>% rename(genome = 1)
}
per_genome <- if (!is.null(genome$count)) {
  table <- longer(genome$count, "count")
  if (!is.null(genome$tpm)) table <- left_join(table, longer(genome$tpm, "tpm"), by = c("genome", "library"))
  if (!is.null(genome$covered)) table <- left_join(table, longer(genome$covered, "covered_bases"), by = c("genome", "library"))
  if (!is.null(genome$length)) table <- left_join(table, longer(genome$length, "length"), by = c("genome", "library"))
  table
} else {
  tibble()
}
if (nrow(per_genome) > 0 && all(c("covered_bases", "length") %in% names(per_genome))) {
  per_genome$covered_pct <- 100 * per_genome$covered_bases / per_genome$length
}
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  if (nrow(per_genome) == 0) {
    no_output("CoverM", "results/quantify/coverm/")
  } else {
    n_genomes <- n_distinct(per_genome$genome)
    para("Reads of **", plural(n_distinct(per_genome$library), "library", "libraries"), "** were counted on **", plural(n_genomes, "genome"), "** of the catalogue.")
    if (nrow(mapping) > 0) {
      rate <- 100 * mapping$primary_mapped / mapping$primary
      para("Between ", fmt_pct(min(rate)), " and ", fmt_pct(max(rate)), " of the reads map to the catalogue (mean ", fmt_pct(mean(rate)), "). This is the share of each ",
           "community that the genomes represent. All abundances below are about this share only.")
    }
    if (n_genomes == 1) {
      para("**With a single genome, TPM carries no information**: it's a share of the genomes, so that genome gets 1,000,000 in every library. Use counts and coverage here.")
    }
  }
})
```

```{r mapping}
section("Reads mapped to the catalogue", {
  if (nrow(mapping) == 0) {
    no_output("Bowtie2 and samtools", "results/quantify/bowtie2/")
  } else {
    table <- mapping %>% mutate(mapped_pct = 100 * primary_mapped / primary, proper_pct = 100 * properly_paired / primary)
    show_table(
      table %>% transmute(Library = library, `Reads` = fmt_int(primary), Mapped = fmt_int(primary_mapped), `Mapped %` = fmt_pct(mapped_pct, 2), `Properly paired %` = fmt_pct(proper_pct, 2)),
      "Reads mapped to the genome catalogue per library, from samtools flagstats",
      "mapping_to_catalogue",
      export = table,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    show_figure(
      table %>%
        mutate(library = factor(library, levels = rev(libraries()))) %>%
        ggplot(aes(mapped_pct, library)) +
        geom_col(fill = PALETTE[[1]]) +
        labs(x = "Reads mapped to the catalogue (%)", y = NULL) +
        theme_report() +
        library_axis(nrow(table)),
      "mapping_to_catalogue",
      "Share of reads that map to the genome catalogue, per library.",
      height = rows_height(nrow(table))
    )
  }
})
```

```{r genomes}
section("Abundance of the genomes", {
  if (nrow(per_genome) == 0) {
    no_output("CoverM", "results/quantify/coverm/")
  } else {
    para(
      "Four measures come from CoverM: **count** is the number of reads on a genome, **length** the genome's length, and **covered bases** the bases with at least one read. ",
      "**TPM** is the count normalized by length and by the library's total on the catalogue. Count isn't comparable between libraries of different depth, and TPM isn't comparable ",
      "when the share of mapped reads differs strongly. The full tables are in `results/quantify/coverm/genome.*.tsv`."
    )
    summary <- per_genome %>%
      group_by(genome) %>%
      summarise(
        length = if ("length" %in% names(per_genome)) max(length) else NA_real_,
        libraries_detected = sum(count > 0),
        reads = sum(count),
        mean_tpm = if ("tpm" %in% names(per_genome)) mean(tpm) else NA_real_,
        mean_covered_pct = if ("covered_pct" %in% names(per_genome)) mean(covered_pct) else NA_real_,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(reads))
    show_table(
      summary %>% transmute(
        Genome = genome, Length = fmt_bp(length), Libraries = fmt_int(libraries_detected), Reads = fmt_int(reads), `Mean TPM` = fmt_int(mean_tpm), `Mean covered` = fmt_pct(mean_covered_pct)
      ),
      "Genomes with the most reads",
      "genomes",
      export = summary,
      max_rows = 25
    )
    per_library <- per_genome %>%
      group_by(library) %>%
      summarise(genomes_detected = sum(count > 0), reads_on_genomes = sum(count), richest = genome[which.max(count)], .groups = "drop")
    show_table(
      per_library %>% transmute(Library = library, `Genomes with reads` = fmt_int(genomes_detected), Reads = fmt_int(reads_on_genomes), `Top genome` = richest),
      "Genomes per library. A genome with reads can still be absent: a few reads can map by chance, so compare covered bases too",
      "genomes_per_library",
      export = per_library,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    if ("covered_pct" %in% names(per_genome)) {
      show_figure(
        ggplot(per_genome, aes(pmax(count, 0.5), covered_pct)) +
          geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6, colour = PALETTE[[1]]) +
          scale_x_log10() +
          labs(x = "Reads on the genome (logarithmic scale)", y = "Genome covered by at least one read (%)") +
          theme_report(),
        "reads_and_breadth",
        "Reads and covered share of each genome in each library. A genome with many reads and low coverage breadth is suspect: its reads may come from a related organism or from a shared region.",
        height = 3.2
      )
    }
    n_genomes <- n_distinct(per_genome$genome)
    if (n_genomes > 1 && "tpm" %in% names(per_genome)) {
      top <- head(arrange(summary, desc(mean_tpm))$genome, 40)
      show_figure(
        per_genome %>%
          filter(genome %in% top) %>%
          mutate(genome = factor(genome, levels = rev(top)), library = factor(library, levels = libraries())) %>%
          ggplot(aes(library, genome, fill = log10(tpm + 1))) +
          geom_tile() +
          scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "log10(TPM + 1)") +
          labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
          theme_report() +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1)),
        "tpm_heatmap",
        "Abundance (TPM) of the genomes with the highest mean TPM.",
        height = max(3, length(top) * 0.16 + 1.4)
      )
      matrix_tpm <- per_genome %>%
        select(genome, library, tpm) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = library, values_from = tpm) %>%
        select(-genome) %>%
        as.matrix()
      if (ncol(matrix_tpm) >= 3 && n_genomes >= 3) {
        logged <- log1p(matrix_tpm)
        logged <- logged[apply(logged, 1, var) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
        if (nrow(logged) >= 3) {
          pca <- prcomp(t(logged), scale. = FALSE)
          variance <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
          coordinates <- tibble(library = rownames(pca$x), PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2])
          write_tsv(coordinates, file.path(ctx$tables, "pca_tpm.tsv"))
          show_figure(
            ggplot(coordinates, aes(PC1, PC2, label = library)) +
              geom_point(colour = PALETTE[[1]], size = 2) +
              geom_text(size = 2.2, vjust = -0.9, check_overlap = TRUE) +
              labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", variance[[1]]), y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", variance[[2]])) +
              theme_report(),
            "pca_tpm",
            "Principal component analysis of log(TPM + 1) of the genomes, as a first look at how libraries differ. For a paper, consider a method for compositional data.",
            height = 3.6
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
})
```

```{r contigs}
section("Abundance of the contigs", {
  if (is.null(contig$count)) {
    no_output("CoverM", "results/quantify/coverm/contig.count.tsv")
  } else {
    table <- longer(contig$count, "count") %>% rename(contig = genome)
    per_library <- table %>%
      group_by(library) %>%
      summarise(contigs_with_reads = sum(count > 0), contigs = n(), reads = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
    show_table(
      per_library %>% transmute(Library = library, Contigs = fmt_int(contigs), `With reads` = fmt_int(contigs_with_reads), Reads = fmt_int(reads)),
      "Contigs of the catalogue with reads, per library. The full tables are in results/quantify/coverm/contig.*.tsv",
      "contigs_per_library",
      export = per_library,
      max_rows = 60
    )
  }
})
```

    " (methods ", paste(unlist(s$genome$methods), collapse = ", "), "; minimum covered fraction ", s$genome$min_covered_fraction %||% "?", ")."
  )
})
